title: Personal OKR weekly check-in — Sophia Nguyen
content:
Week: 2026-04-06 → 2026-04-12
Summary: quick sync / personal check-in for Q2 OKRs — mostly focused on SDK quickstart, onboarding flow improvements, and reducing first-run friction. Mixed progress: shipped docs and tutorial, still blocked on infra for reproducible examples (gpu vs cpu mismatch).

Objectives and KRs (personal, Q2 2026)
O1: Improve SDK adoption and first-time developer success
- KR1: Increase quickstart completions from 1.0k → 1.5k / month (measured by quickstart-run event) — current: 1,080 (18% progress toward target).
- KR2: Reduce median time-to-first-successful-call from 12m → 6m — current: ~9m (50% progress).
- KR3: Ship 3 reproducible example notebooks (cpu + docker + hosted) — 1/3 shipped (published tutorial + quickstart script), 2 still pending.

O2: Improve SDK quality and reduce bugs in first week
- KR1: Lower critical bug reports from new users in first week by 30% — baseline 35, current 28 (20% reduction).
- KR2: Add end-to-end integration test harness covering quickstart flows — in progress, CI job prototyped but flaky on GPU runner.

Progress this week (what I actually did)
- Published new quickstart tutorial (docs + example repo) — link above.
- Fixed two doc typos and clarified auth flow for private deployments.
- Created first draft of reproducible docker example (cpu-only) and added to examples repo.
- Paired with Hunter to debug flaky CI on GPU runner; narrowed to mismatch in default CUDA env between examples and infra images.
- Wrote acceptance criteria for quickstart e2e tests and added acceptance checklist to Linear ticket SDK-210.

Blockers / open questions
- GPU runner infra mismatch: ops needs to standardize base image tags (NCCL/CUDA). Asked infra channel on Slack but waiting on ops response (punted to next week if no resolution).
- Telemetry gap: quickstart-run event is firing for hosted flows but not for docker quickstart (missing instrumentation). Need to coordinate with analytics to add event, filed Linear ticket.
- UX question: do we continue to show both hosted and local quickstart on landing page? Confusing for new users. Suggest A/B test but need product approval.

Risks / mitigation
- If GPU image mismatch isn't resolved, reproducible examples will lag and KR3 will be at risk. Mitigation: publish CPU-only notebooks and mark GPU examples as "coming soon" with clear notes.
- Flaky CI prevents reliable e2e gating -> short term: mark tests as optional and run nightly to collect failures; medium term: rework runner images with ops.

Next week plan (concrete tasks)
- Follow up with infra/ops on base image tags and get a decision by Tue 2026-04-14. (Owner: ops + Hunter assist)
- Add telemetry to docker quickstart (instrument quickstart-run event) — coordinate with analytics and test locally. (Owner: me)
- Ship 2nd reproducible example (docker + CPU) and open PR for review. (Owner: me)
- Draft A/B test proposal about landing page quickstart choices and share with product for feedback by EOW. (Owner: me)
- Continue pairing with Hunter on flaky CI; if unresolved by Thu, switch to nightly-run mitigation.

Retro / notes to self
- Keep PRs small and add screenshots for onboarding docs — reviewers appreciate less context switching.
- When pairing with ops, bring a minimal repro that runs in their environment to reduce back-and-forth.
- Document the exact env diff that caused the GPU flakiness so we can prevent similar issues.

Meeting / 1:1 topics for next sync
- Ask for product guidance on landing page A/B for quickstarts.
- Request allocation of 1 dev hour from ops to sync on base image tagging and release schedule.
- Clarify priority for reproducible GPU examples vs. broader telemetry coverage.

TODO (short list)
- [ ] Add quickstart-run instrumentation to docker example
- [ ] Open PR for cpu docker example (target Tue)
- [ ] Follow up in #infra on Slack about CUDA base image (target Mon)
- [ ] Draft A/B test proposal for product (target Fri)

Random fragments / working notes (raw)
- "maybe collapse hosted/local quickstart into single path with toggle? pros/cons"
- "analytics: event schema needs property 'quickstart_type' (hosted|docker|notebook)"
- "consider short video GIF for landing page rather than two separate quickstarts"

References / links
- SDK quickstart repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/tree/main/examples/quickstart
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342
- Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/SDK-210

Status: draft — want to refine before copying to Confluence for Q2 personal OKR page.
